title: Nvidia's Quadratic Processor: The NV1 (Famous Graphics Chips series)
author: Jon Peddie
notes: NV1 (1995) rendered quadratic surfaces; Direct3D standardised on triangles; NVIDIA dropped the approach in a turnaround to polygons; Sega's next-console chip (NV2) was dropped. Publication year approximate. Content via web-search snippets (fetch not attempted).

title: Nvidia's RIVA 128 (Famous Graphics Chips series)
author: Jon Peddie
notes: RIVA 128 (NV3) introduced in 1H 1997 with triangle primitives and Direct3D compatibility; NVIDIA had basically no customers and greatly reduced staff before it; revenue ploughed back into R&D. Publication year approximate. Content via web-search snippets.
